name: add_high_pass_filter
mechanism: Applies a high-pass filter to the synthesized signal to remove DC offset and introduce physiological undershoot.
code_snippet: b_hp, a_hp = butter(2, 0.5 / nyq, btype='high'); signal = filtfilt(b_hp, a_hp, signal)

name: add_systolic_shoulder_component
mechanism: Introduces a third Gaussian component to the pulse morphology to model the systolic shoulder, widening the peak and slowing the initial decay.

name: reduce_high_pass_cutoff
mechanism: Lowering the high-pass filter cutoff frequency preserves the low-frequency components of the PPG signal, preventing excessive waveform distortion and artificially deep valleys.

name: increase_high_pass_cutoff
mechanism: Increasing the high-pass filter cutoff frequency enhances waveform morphology by creating deeper valleys and steepening the rise time.

name: lower_high_pass_cutoff_frequency
mechanism: Lowering the high-pass filter cutoff frequency from 0.5 Hz to 0.25 Hz preserves low-frequency physiological components and prevents artificial waveform distortion.
